name: Your Shopify/WooCommerce Chatbot and Automation Tasks in n8n

parameters.content:
## Your Shopify/WooCommerce Chatbot and Automation Tasks in n8n

### How it works
- A shopper asks in your store chat. Claude sorts it: order status, product question or a person.
- One Config value picks Shopify or WooCommerce. Orders and stock come from your live store, never from the model.
- An order is only described when the email on it matches what the shopper typed.
- Late unshipped orders get flagged to you, every chat is logged, and a person takes over by email.
- The sample chat is made up, since the post names no store.

### Setup
- Set store_platform, your inboxes and your sheet in 0 - Config: Your Settings.
- Shopify: an app with read_orders and read_products, its token in a Header Auth credential (X-Shopify-Access-Token).
- WooCommerce: a Read REST API key in a Basic Auth credential.
- Connect Claude, Gmail and Google Sheets, then add the chat embed to your store theme.

### What I need from you
- Which platform you are on, or both, and staff or collaborator access.
- Your shipping promise in days, your support email and your reply time.
- A handful of real shopper questions to test against.
- Which stores this runs on. Each store gets its own copy and Config.

Your part 3, building and improving workflows. Every chat lands in a Google Sheet with the question, the answer and whether a person was needed, so each improvement comes from real chats.

## 4 - CONNECTING SYSTEMS: YOUR INBOX TAKES OVER

Your part 4, connecting systems. Refunds, cancellations and anything the bot should not guess go to your inbox with the chat and the order, and your reply goes straight to the shopper.

options.systemMessage: You read every message in an online store's chat and sort it before anything is looked up. The store runs on Shopify or WooCommerce; you never look anything up and never answer the shopper yourself. Return one intent: order_status (where is my order, has it shipped, tracking, delivery date) only when the chat so far has both an order number and the email used at checkout; need_details when they ask about an order but one of those two is missing; product_question (sizes, colours, materials, stock, price, which product to pick); human (refund, return, exchange, cancellation, damaged or wrong item, address change, payment problem, complaint, or they ask for a person); other (anything else, including empty or abusive messages). Read the earlier messages in this chat: an order number given two messages ago still counts. Set wants_person to true for human, and also when an order or product question comes with a refund, return, cancel or complaint request, and say why in handoff_reason in one short sentence. order_number is the number only, without the # sign. email is lowercase and exactly as typed; never guess or complete one. product_query is the few words a catalog search should match, such as linen pillow cover, and stays empty unless intent is product_question.

5 - One Shape for Either Store, Email Must Match
nodes.notes: Someone typing a stranger's order number gets nothing back. Your store decides what is true, never the model.

messageValues.message: You write the reply a shopper sees in an online store's chat. Sound like a helpful person on the store's team: warm, plain words, no emojis, 2 to 4 sentences. Use only the store data you are given and never guess an order status, a delivery date, a price or stock. If intent is need_details, ask for the order number and the email used at checkout. If intent is order_status and order_found or email_matches is false, say you could not find an order with that number and email, ask them to check both, and share nothing else about any order. For a shipped order give the carrier, the tracking link and the delivery estimate when there is one. If late is true, say the order has not shipped yet, apologise once, and say the team has been told. For product_question answer from the products list only: name, price, in stock or not, and the link; if nothing matches, say so and offer to pass the question to the team. If wants_person is true, say a person from the team will email them within the reply time given, and ask for their email if shopper_email is empty. Never promise a refund, a cancellation, a discount or a delivery date the data does not show; a person decides those.
